Sam (People Ops): Quick ask 3 can folks drop 2-line peer-feedback templates and a tiny rubric we can surface on the review form? Also want a hiring-feedback variant that maps to performance signals.
Evan (PM): Yep - handy if they're paste-ready. I try to keep peer feedback: observed fact + impact + one suggestion.
Noor (IC): Paste-ready peer feedback (2 lines):
```
Observed: Led the streaming cache refactor, reduced p95 latency ~18%.
Impact & ask: Improved customer throughput; suggest adding an e2e perf test before next deploy.
```
Maya (Recruiter): Hiring-feedback card (compact):
```
Strengths: clear system tradeoffs and testable plan.
Development area: limited async workload exposure; probe with a short pairing task.
Recommendation: Strong / Hire-with-mentor / Not-now
```
Tom (Eng Mgr): Minimal manager rubric (3-point, one-line each):
```
5 - Outstanding: Repeatedly delivers high-impact results and elevates others.
3 - Solid: Meets commitments with reliable outcomes.
1 - Needs support: Missed key deliverables; needs clear plan and coaching.
```
Sam (People Ops): One-line impact headlines for self-reviews (examples):
```
- Launched streaming cache: reduced infra cost by 30% and cut tail latency.
- Fixed tokenization bug: decreased support tickets by 40% and improved error rate.
```
Evan (PM): Could we also provide an "upward feedback" starter pack for ICs? Short and non-awkward.
Noor (IC): Upward feedback starter (paste):
```
- One thing my manager did well this cycle: [specific behavior with example].
- One thing that would help me grow: [concrete ask or support needed].
```
hr-bot: Reminder: performance calibration window opens 2026-04-01. Finish manager check-ins at least 2 weeks prior. :calendar:
Sam (People Ops): Great suggestions 3 I'll collate these into a one-pager "feedback cheat-sheet" and attach it to review invites. Ping me if you want alternate phrasings. :thumbsup:
